slashDescription: Start a design on the canvas, or open it
nativeUnsupported: The design canvas runs in the Paseo desktop and web apps. Open this workspace there to see and comment on designs.
pageMissing: This artboard's page could not be read.
noCommentsYet: No comments yet. Switch to Comment (C) and click an element in a design.
noCommentsYetComment: Click an element in a design to comment on it. Hold Alt to pick the exact element.
agentBusy: The agent is working. Send when it finishes.
startedDesign: Sent to the agent. The design appears here as it is drawn.
noSuchPage: This design has no artboard for {{file}}
notMovable: Only elements with a data-dc-id can be moved. Ask the agent to give this one an id.
notMovableUnit: This element is placed with percentages, so it can't be dragged here.
moveConflict: {{file}} changed on disk, so the move was not saved. The page was reloaded.
tweaksEmpty: No tweaks yet. Ask the agent to pick the values worth tuning, such as colors, spacing and layout.
tweaksAsked: Sent to the agent. The tweaks appear here when it's done.
tweaksHint: Changes show right away and are saved to tweaks.css.
tweakUnused: No page uses {{var}} yet, so this does nothing.
notEditable: There's no text here to edit.
notEditableSvg: Text inside an SVG can't be edited here. Comment on it instead.
textConflict: {{file}} changed on disk, so the text was not saved. The page was reloaded.
tweaksApplying: Sent to the agent. It puts these values into the design's CSS and defaults.
designDeleted: Deleted “{{title}}”. It's in {{path}} if you want it back.
designImportedKept: Imported “{{title}}”. Kept this workspace's own {{files}}, which differ from the design's copy.
briefPlaceholder: What do you want to design?
dropZipOnly: Drop a .zip exported from a design canvas.
